basic_details.job_title: PAU Assistant Security Supervisor Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Punjab Agricultural University (PAU), Ludhiana has invited applications for one post of Assistant Security Supervisor on a fixed monthly pay of Rs.14,286/- (on contract) at the Fruit Research Station, Jallowal Lesriwal (Jalandhar). Applications are made on plain paper and sent to the office of the Head, Department of Fruit Science, PAU, Ludhiana, by 11 December 2026; applications received after that date will not be considered. Applicants appear for an interview on 18 December 2026 at 11:00 AM.

content_sections.heading: PAU Assistant Security Supervisor at a Glance

rows.details: Application on plain paper sent to the Head, Department of Fruit Science, PAU, Ludhiana
11 December 2026 (late applications will not be considered)

content_sections.heading: About PAU
content_sections.text: Punjab Agricultural University is based in Ludhiana, Punjab. This notice is issued from the office of the Head, Department of Fruit Science, PAU Ludhiana, and is addressed to all Deans, Directors, other officers and Heads of Departments at PAU Ludhiana and to the Directors and sub-stations at outside stations. The post is to be filled under the Incharge, Fruit Research Station, Jallowal Lesriwal (Jalandhar).

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Send the application to the Head, Department of Fruit Science, PAU, Ludhiana. The notice prints no PIN code, email address, postal mode or envelope instruction. The recruitments page on pau.edu carries a link to download a form for this post. The notice itself asks for an application on plain paper.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Post and vacancy: Assistant Security Supervisor, 1 post, on fixed pay (on contract). Qualification: Middle with Punjabi. Age: 18 years to 58 years. The notice prints no date for counting age and lists no age relaxation. Desirable: preference to candidates who have been working as DPLs in the respective fields in PAU for 5 years. Pay: Rs.14,286/- (Rs.13486+Rs.800) per month, fixed. Place: Incharge, Fruit Research Station, Jallowal Lesriwal (Jalandhar). Candidates should check the official notification for any further eligibility detail for the post.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Attested copies of certificates. Bank draft of Rs. 100 in the name of Comptroller, PAU (application fee). Original certificates, to be brought at the time of the interview.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applicants appear for an interview before the Selection Committee on 18 December 2026 at 11:00 AM, in the office of the Head, Department of Fruit Science, PAU Ludhiana. Original certificates must be brought to the interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Incomplete applications and applications received after the last date will not be considered. No TA/DA will be given for attending the interview. The application fee is Rs. 100, paid by bank draft in the name of Comptroller, PAU.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in PAU Assistant Security Supervisor recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for the post of Assistant Security Supervisor, to be filled at the Fruit Research Station, Jallowal Lesriwal (Jalandhar).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date is 11 December 2026. Incomplete applications and those received after the last date will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: The qualification is Middle with Punjabi. Preference is given to candidates who have been working as DPLs in the respective fields in PAU for 5 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 years to 58 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the post?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs.14,286/- (Rs.13486+Rs.800) per month, fixed, on contract.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee and how is it paid?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 100, paid by a bank draft in the name of Comptroller, PAU, which is sent with the application.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Prepare an application on plain paper and attach attested copies of certificates and the bank draft. Send it to the Head, Department of Fruit Science, PAU, Ludhiana, by 11 December 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What should the application mention?
faq.answer: The application must mention the name of the post, the advertisement number, the date and the mobile number.

faq.question: Q9. How are candidates selected, and when is the interview?
faq.answer: Applicants appear for an interview before the Selection Committee on 18 December 2026 at 11:00 AM in the office of the Head, Department of Fruit Science, PAU Ludhiana, with original certificates.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be given for attending the interview.
